verdict.rationale: Jules explicitly supports background autonomous task execution via cloud VMs, GitHub-label task assignment, and a public API with an `automationMode` field for building custom automated workflows integrated with tools like Slack/Linear/GitHub (jules-docs-3, jules-docs-2, jules-docs-9, jules-docs-11, jules-docs-16). Community reports corroborate real background/async usage (e.g. PRs appearing after leaving tasks running, third-party MCP dispatch of tasks) (jules-comm-12, jules-comm-16, jules-comm-19). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/cron-style recurring automations and independent verification of reliability at scale beyond anecdotal reports.
